title: Conan: A Strange Child
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Kogoro Mouri, Conan, Inspector Megure, Takagi, Chiba) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Old cases/ep433 file (s1 Umezu Takashi, s2 Touru Mikami, s3 Chika Araki; murderer_id s2) had the correct culprit -- Mikami is confirmed by the transcript -- so no culprit reversal here, unlike some other rebuilds. However the old file understated the plot: it omitted the real motive entirely (Mikami secretly ghostwrote Umezu's award-winning novel and was forbidden from ever taking public credit), omitted Takashi's blackmail of his own father over drug use and Mikami's subsequent frame-up of Takashi with that same drug stash, and omitted Chika Araki's red-herring accusation (Takashi falsely claims she ghostwrote the book). The old file's clue c2 called the dying-message object a 'trophy'; it is actually a hand-carved Ichii-wood ceremonial stick given as an award memento, and the dying message itself has two layers -- a surface misdirection (upside-down kanji reading 'raku-ki' ~ Takashi's catchphrase 'lucky') and the true layer (Umezu's whole bibliography is built from palindromes, the same property as the name 'Mikami'). case_type: murder. Temporal/order fields intentionally omitted per current build guidance.

clues.desc: Button torn from Mikami's blazer found stuck to the sofa by the gum Umezu had been chewing -- proves a struggle with Mikami specifically.
Every title on Umezu's bookshelf and the manuscript's odd phrase are palindromes -- his hidden signature technique, the same property as the name "Mikami".
